messages:
Priya: Quick check — finalizing rollout for the April price experiment. Need confirmation on grandfathering rules for customers with reserved capacity + promo vouchers.
Omar: Thanks — main open: do we keep full grandfathered rate for reserved contracts or apply partial reduction? Legal prefers full for term contracts.
Jules: We also have to make sure meter exporter flags legacy_rate=true so invoice job doesn't reprice historical usage.
Priya: Right. BillingJob change is small but needs migration: set legacy_rate tag on usage rows for customers in cohort A.
Maya: Can someone paste the cohort assignment rule? I want to run a dry-run.
Omar: Rule is: assign by account_id % 100 < 20 -> control; 20-50 -> cohort-A (grandfather); else cohort-B (new rate).
Maya: Nice. I'll run it against July-September data.
Priya: Also vendor question: Stripe connector will need to send invoice_line_items with price_override_meta. @Vik do we have ok from payments?
Vik: I talked to payments. They need a mapping table. Send CSV with columns: account_id, legacy_flag, rate_id_override.
Priya: Sending sample below:
Priya: ```
account_id,legacy_flag,rate_id_override
acct_123,true,rate_legacy_2024
acct_456,false,rate_new_2026
```
Jules: For the reconciliation script, note: do not backfill tokens for already-billed invoices; only future billing windows.
Maya: Dry run results: 1.2% of accounts moved cohorts unexpectedly — looks like some accounts had multiple sub-accounts. I'll open a follow-up thread.
Omar: For approvals we need finance + legal signoff. @Maya please tag a snapshot in Notion and ping Legal.
Priya: I'll consolidate action items: 1) Maya run dry run + share CSV, 2) Omar prepare migration PR for BillingJob, 3) Vik to confirm Stripe mapping window, 4) Legal signoff. Target: ship canary next Tue.
BillingBot: Deploy scheduled: billing-migration-pr-421 -> canary on 2026-04-06 02:00 UTC (ETA 20m)
Vik: LGTM on timeline, Legal says they can review by EOD Mon if PR is up.
Priya: Great. If no objections, I'll mark this as ready and create the rollout checklist in the console. :rocket: 
Maya: quick Q — how do we handle promo vouchers attached to legacy accounts? Keep them at current nominal value or reprice? 
Jules: Keep nominal value but add note on invoice lines: 'promo honored at original rate' so support can reconcile.
Priya: OK that's resolved. Closing actions — will update thread when PR is open.
